titulo_it: Quando sono tornato, era tutto cambiato

texto: For what was going on: imfect. For what happened: prossimo passato. For the above: trapassate.
Example: **Quando sono tornato, la piazza era vuota, perché tutti erano andati** (when I returned, the square was empty, because they were all gone).
**Era cambiato** means «had changed»: it is trapassate, prior to another time past. **era diverso** (was different) or **era vuoto** (was empty) is used to describe a state.
**Non c'era più** = no longer was / no longer.

frases.it: Quando sono tornato a Roma, tutto era cambiato.
frases.es: Cuando volví a Roma, todo había cambiado.
frases.en: When I returned to Rome, everything had changed.

frases.it: E la piazza vicino a casa?

frases.en: I remembered you were always there.
Yeah, he went there every day.

opciones.explicacion: Trapassate with «essere» and participle with «tutto».
It would respond to the prossimo passage: «tutto è cambiato».
It corresponds to the present time: «tutto cambia».

bloques.frase: Il bar storico della piazza non ___ più.

opciones.explicacion: singular «esserci» imperfect to indicate that it no longer existed there.
It is the present of the indicative: «He's not here.».
It is the form of plural: «They're not here.».

opciones.texto: I remembered you were always there.
opciones.explicacion: «Ricordavo» in imperfect and «ci andavi» with locative particle.

opciones.texto: I remembered you went there once.
opciones.explicacion: Such a timely action would require prossimo passage.
That phrase would be formulated in the present time.
It describes a background state in the past with the adjective feminine «vuota».

opciones.texto: The square was full of people.
opciones.explicacion: Full or full in Italian is «pieno».
This interpretation places the fact in the present.

bloques.frase: Siamo tornati di nuovo in quella piazza
bloques.explicacion: Prayer with prossimo passage and the «di nuovo» locution.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the trapassate of the reflexive verb (man).
bloques.frase: Non ho comprato il pane perché mi ___ dimenticato.

opciones.explicacion: The reflexive verbs form all times composed of «essere».
Reflective verbs never match «avere».
«Sono dimenticato» is prossimo passate, not anterior trapassate.

bloques.pregunta: What is the meaning of the reflexive verb «ricordarsi»?

opciones.explicacion: Reflective verb linked to personal memory.
Forgetting in Italian is expressed with «dimenticarsi».
Getting up is «alzarsi».

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «I had lost the keys.»?

opciones.explicacion: The verb «perdere» is transient and governs auxiliary «avere».
«Perdere» is neither reflective nor of intransitive movement.

opciones.texto: Avevo perduto le chiavi da ieri.
opciones.explicacion: Although «perduto» exists, «perso» is the usual standard participle.

intro: When you tell a memory, you mix the background (how it was), what happened and what had happened before. That's what good narrators do.
